dedupe_keys.name: office of rail and road orr data portal rail statistics for great britain

description: The data portal of the Office of Rail and Road, the rail regulator for Great Britain, publishes official rail statistics. It covers usage (passenger, regional and freight rail usage and estimates of station usage), performance (passenger rail performance, cancellations and performance at stations), passenger experience, accessibility, finance (fares and industry finance), health and safety (rail safety, occupational health and common safety indicators) and infrastructure and environment (rail infrastructure and assets, asset condition and rail environment), with compendia and key statistics per train operating company. The rail safety tables listed on data.gov.uk include fatalities and injuries, assaults, signals passed at danger on the mainline and train accidents by severity. Coverage is national (Great Britain), with releases through the year, for example rail safety for April 2025 to March 2026 published on 24 September 2026. Tables are free under the Open Government Licence and downloadable as ODS and other spreadsheet formats. Caveats: the data are aggregated statistics by operator, region or period, not asset-level records. They support rail demand and performance inputs for network models, safety and asset condition trend analysis and resilience studies of disruption. They complement the Network Rail open data feeds and the National Rail Darwin feeds catalogued here.
